[LTIM.3.2.2] `tz` is a zone designation: exactly `"UTC"`, which needs no
fact ([LTIM.10.8]), or any other string, which the host's `TimeZoneOffset`
facts resolve ([LTIM.10.7]). Resolution yields a fixed **seconds** offset
valid at `t.utc_ns`; the runtime multiplies that offset by 1e9 to
store `tz_offset_ns` on the resolved `Time` — a single lossless
conversion at construction (a tz offset is never sub-second).
The offset is as DST-correct as the facts the host supplies ([LTIM.10.10]).
